motion_rule: the ice tray slides her down the market aisle all clip while counters, crates and the seller sweep across and burst at the lens every beat; the camera tracks alongside, her head to the lens and half the frame; new shot size each beat, one big action per beat; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a plump mackerel with a mirror-striped flank, upright on her tail, jaw working, eye always clear
second_characters: ONE heavy seller in a white cap and stained apron, big in frame a shoulder from the lens, hauling crates alongside then grabbing her
props: ONE price card reading 3999 propped in the ice beside her, on screen from the first beat; A SWARM of grey salmon heads with a paper card of a soup pot stuck flat on them
prop_continuity: the 3999 card rides the tray beside her from 0.00; the salmon heads come off her tail at 2.10 and lie under the soup pot card from 2.95 on
environment: a fish hall at noon, daylight flooding through the roof windows, tiled counters and crates a fin away both sides of the aisle, crushed ice heaped along them, no far wall
light_events: flat white noon off the tiles and the ice, a hard mirror flash down her flank at 5.70

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a smug oily female voice, biting each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: prosh-LI, vre-me-NA, lo-SO-sya, te-PER, ma-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, ty, BU-desh, rad, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.55-2.95, 3.55-6.35 and 6.35-8.75 each one breath; after 8.75 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: ice crunching, trays scraping tile, crates banging, a scale clanging

timeline.a: the tray shoves off down the aisle, ice spraying across the frame
she rears up off the ice and swings her head to the lens
she rides the sliding tray past a crate that rakes across behind her
her tail whips and hurls the grey salmon heads sideways off the tray at the lens
the heads slap down on the tile and the seller drops the soup pot card flat on them
she squares her shoulders and shoves the 3999 card upright with her nose
she throws her whole body over and the tray skids under her
she rises on her tail, fins spread wide
she arcs her striped flank at the lens and the light rips down it
she leans in at the lens, jaw wide, ice bursting up around her
the seller sweeps in across the whole frame, crates banging past, and scoops the tray out from under her
she is swung through the air still talking, the aisle wheeling behind her
the seller slams her flat on the scales, the needle whipping round, and rams her into a bag
the bag goes into the buyer's hands while the seller picks her teeth with a fish bone and grins at the lens

must_appear: the 3999 card beside her from first beat to last; at 2.10 her tail hurls the grey salmon heads off the tray and the soup pot card lands on them; at 8.75 the seller in the white cap slams her on the scales and bags her; at 9.40 the seller picks her teeth with a bone and grins into the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, cyrillic letters, words, a parked camera, a closed jaw while speaking, slow motion, a camera pulling back, an empty aisle, a far wall, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines
